# twingatetunnel Provider

Runs the Twingate Client (`twingated`) in unprivileged userspace HTTP-proxy mode for the duration of a Terraform run, so other providers can reach private Twingate Resources. Works on HCP Terraform hosted workers: no root, TUN device, custom image or agent is needed. Linux only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cache_dir` (String) Directory for the downloaded client and libraries. Defaults to `<tmp>/twingatetunnel/cache`.
- `client_path` (String) Path to a preinstalled `twingated` binary. When set, nothing is downloaded. Useful for agents and local development.
- `client_sha256` (String) Hex SHA-256 of the `.deb` at `client_url`.
- `client_url` (String) URL of a `twingate` `.deb` to download instead of reading the Twingate apt index, e.g. from an internal artifact store. Requires `client_sha256`.
- `client_version` (String) Version of the `twingate` package to download from the Twingate apt repository, e.g. `2026.239.6882`. Defaults to the newest version available. Pin this for repeatable runs.
- `fetch_missing_libraries` (Boolean) Download shared libraries that `twingated` needs but the host lacks (for example `libcryptsetup.so.12`, `libnl-3.so.200`) from the frozen Ubuntu 20.04 release repository, verified by SHA-256. Defaults to `true`.
- `log_dir` (String) Directory for supervisor and `twingated` logs. Defaults to `<tmp>/twingatetunnel/logs`.
- `service_key` (String, Sensitive) Twingate Service Account key (the full JSON document). Defaults to the `TWINGATE_SERVICE_KEY` environment variable. It is passed to `twingated` through its environment only and never written to disk.
